implementation_decision: Attribute NYC TLC/City of New York, exact source versions/hashes and aggregation/geometry modifications. Retain informational-use/no-accuracy-guarantee context. Do not label the data Apache-2.0 or CC0, use City logos, or imply endorsement. Include only bounded aggregate counts and simplified GIS data, not raw trips.
basis: City public data policy and section23-502(d) describe unrestricted public data use subject to source/version/modification identification; the technical standards explicitly address republishing and application use. TLC states that vendors supplied the records and does not warrant their accuracy.
